title: Nice enough but 25 for another T-shirt - no thanks
text: Actually, even though it said ti was a mystery t-shirt box, I thought it would have more ancillary items in it. The puzzle was interesting but that plus the t-shirt isn't worth $25. IF you come up with an answer to the puzzle, you can enter it in their website and be entered into a drawing for a prize.  Odds are small enough that,for me, the t-shirt alone doesn't make it worth $25.  How many t-shirts does an adult really need? Will search for a more engaging subscription box.
label: neutral
